unused_cache.scope: Use the package manager unused-cache cleanup and its in-use lock. Do not remove caches manually, force past locks, or modify project results or jobs.

prebuilt_wheel_cache.scope: Use the documented prebuilt-wheel cleanup through uv, preserving its in-use locks and project results. Running owned service packages use regular hardlinks in their external virtual environment.

report_change: Remove obsolete20-versus26 selection fields from future checkpoint-screen summaries. The training configuration remains the single owner of the236-question dataset. Existing baseline outputs are preserved.

validation.pytest_command: uv run --no-project --with pytest python -m pytest --confcutdir=tests/fast tests/fast/test_tcs_checkpoint_screen.py tests/fast/test_tcs_screen_comparison.py -q
validation.note: The initial unrestricted pytest invocation loaded unrelated GPU fixtures and lacked numpy; the isolated CPU test suite passed.
